messages:
maria: Atlas just reported an intake exception at AMS-DC2 — 12 H200s affected: 8 DOA, 2 serial-tag swaps, 2 mismatched firmware tags. They're asking if we want immediate air-replacement or to wait for the scheduled sea replenishment.
sam: can you paste AWB and depot photos? need to log evidence for claims.
vendor-atlas: AWB: 123-00098765
Carrier: SkyRail
ETA: 2025-08-05 10:00 CEST
Shipment: 200 H200s
Issue summary: 8 DOA (power rail failure), 2 serial tag swaps, 2 firmware-annotation mismatch (clearly a packing label error)
Photos: https://atlas.example/photos/rc4502-ams-intake.zip
Depot: AMS-DC2
alex: what's air vs sea leadtime/cost? and can AMS stage replacements same-day if we push loaners from a nearby depot?
vendor-atlas: sea ETA: 5-7 weeks. air expedite ETA: 4 days. air surcharge = $1,500/unit + brokerage; sea = no surcharge. AMS can stage up to 10 loaners same-day if we provide ASN.
jin: infra: EU-dedicated pool at 0.93. Losing 8 puts us ~0.86 which breaks reserved commit SLAs for two tenants. NA transfer not allowed for those tenants (data locality). we need minimum 6 immediately.
sam: so plan: air-replace 6 DOA critical SKUs, hold 2 DOA for depot swap verification, ground-replace 4 after manifest reconciliation? what's warranty cover?
procurement-bot: PO #RC-4502 attached. Warranty: vendor liable for DOA within 30 days. Procurement pre-approved expedite up to $20k for this PO. Please attach expense codes CAPEX-ENG-HW.
maria: can we do a stagger: 6 air, 2 local loaners AMS staging, hold 4 for serial/firmware audit? saves cost and keeps pool healthy.
vendor-atlas: we can do 6 air now (RMA pending), 2 loaners from nearby depot (no charge, temp), and hold 4 for audit. AMS-DC2 can hold units for 10 calendar days.
ops-bot: Reminder: update inventory tracker with RMA before AWB change. Use format rma:RC-4502-ATLAS-1.
sam: inventory update snippet for ops: ```
# run on ops-console
python infra/inventory.py --rma RC-4502-ATLAS-1 --add 6 --location AMS-DC2 --note "air expedite"
```
alex: please ensure Atlas provides CSV manifest of corrected serials before we ingest. we don't want manual reassign work.
vendor-atlas: CSV manifest will be provided 2 hours before pickup: https://atlas.example/csvs/RC-4502-manifest.csv
vendor-atlas: RMA auth requested: awaiting RMA number from our returns team.
maria: procurement, confirm expedite accounting and threshold.
procurement-bot: confirm: accounting code CAPEX-ENG-HW, expedite fee ok up to $20k. expense under RC-4502. If surcharge > $20k, escalate to finance.
sam: sound. jin — once we have AWB+manifest I'll apply routing fallback to keep traffic off impacted hosts. add +15% capacity buffer for EU dedicated pool while replacements inbound.
jin: applying routing adjustments now. putting affected hostgroup into maintenance-pref with fallback pools. ping when AWB updated.
vendor-atlas: RMA issued: RMA-AT-8850. AWB updated: 123-00098765 (RMA-AT-8850). Pickup booked 2025-08-06 04:00 UTC.
maria: thanks. grant Atlas permission to include RMA tag on AWB and to share depot sign-off photo on delivery.
vendor-atlas: will attach sign-off photos and final CSV after pickup. manifest link updated: https://atlas.example/csvs/RMA-AT-8850-manifest.csv
sam: nice. also request a short note from AMS-DC2 QA about packing root cause so we can feed back to vendor quality team.
vendor-atlas: AMS-DC2 QA note: packing label printer misaligned; vendor dispatch investigating.
alex: filed follow-up ticket: OPS-7892 to verify serial reconciliation next week and confirm firmware annotation fix.
jin: health-check after routing change: EU-dedicated-pool now 0.95 avail with buffer, tail latency unaffected in last 20m. closing loop unless new alerts.
maria: closing — reopen if AWB/manifest not received or if depot photos show more damage. :white_check_mark:
